name: Ricardo Vargas
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karts in Lima. He excelled in mechanical engineering, leading him to work on rally cars before transitioning to single-seaters. His meticulous nature and problem-solving skills quickly made him an asset to various racing teams. 

As a technical director, Ricardo emphasizes data analysis and practical solutions over radical innovations. He believes in building a strong, reliable car first, and then refining it based on driver feedback. His pragmatic approach is valued by his team, who appreciate his clear communication and dedication to continuous improvement. He aims to build a strong foundation for ART Grand Prix.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen.
Insists on brewing his own coffee with a specific Peruvian blend.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on his desk when deep in thought.
